hero.title: Become a Bridge Keeper
hero.desc: Behind 600+ smooth crossings stands a crew of Bridge Keepers. Check-in, wayfinding, livestream, photography, guest reception — pick a post and keep the day with us.
hero.cta: Apply to Be a Bridge Keeper

roles.title: Six Keeper Posts
roles.sub: Every post comes with training and shift rotations. No experience required — just bring your sense of responsibility.

form.title: Ready to Keep the Bridge?
form.phonePlaceholder: For urgent contact before the event
form.notePlaceholder: Availability / relevant experience — a sentence or two is plenty
form.note: Applications close 2026.09.30 · results by email before 10.08
form.privacy: By submitting, you agree that we process your name, email, optional phone, and preferred role solely for volunteer scheduling and contact. Data is stored in the organizers' Feishu base and an encrypted backup, retained per the organizers' retention policy after the event.
form.doneBody: We've received your Bridge Keeper application ({{role}}). The result will be emailed to {{email}} before 10.08.
form.errorFallback: Submission failed. Please try again later.
